title: ARWP Data Authority Experiments
purpose: Test whether useful original data exposed as stable evidence-bearing entity pages can improve Search, generative Search, AI citation and acquisition outcomes without treating page scale, structured data or graph metadata as ranking factors.

defaultExperiment.control: Use comparable unchanged pages where practical; otherwise preserve a dated pre-change baseline.
defaultExperiment.baseline: Capture owner-side Search/AI/referral evidence before intervention when available.
interventions: add genuinely useful entity attributes or derived facts
make the direct answer visible in canonical HTML
add evidence, methodology, provenance or limitations where applicable
align page-visible facts with Dataset/JSON/CSV/JSON-LD representations
add meaningful parent, related-entity and comparison links
remove or exclude thin duplicate/query-variant pages from Search
stopConditions: new cohorts repeatedly add no unique user value
index/crawl noise grows faster than useful discovery
the experiment requires fabricated evidence or metadata
privacy, licensing or safety boundaries cannot be satisfied

sites.primaryQuestion: Can high-value voice-training entity pages acquire real non-brand Search traffic and later AI citations?
Can structured professional knowledge and datasets create qualified discovery rather than only informational impressions?
Do stable language-pattern entities gain useful long-tail query coverage and machine retrieval?
Can bounded reviewed practice records be discovered without turning safety-sensitive material into a page factory?
Can a large conceptual entity library win useful long-tail discovery through distinct data and relationships?
Which parts of a large GitHub Pages knowledge library produce real demand and which parts create only index noise?
Can data-rich professional pages outperform generic mixed-domain content on discovery and qualified visits?
